components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action (Fetch data, Quick Start). Amber gradient, dark text at rest; deep amber + white text on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 18px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D97706, #B45309); color: #1C1209; box-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(217,119,6,0.27); transition: all 0.15s ease; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #B45309, #92400E); color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(217,119,6,0.4); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; transform: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions (Apply, cancel). Transparent with border, Warm Stone text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 7px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.10); cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; background: transparent; color: #57534E; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #D97706; color: #1C1209; background: rgba(217,119,6,0.05); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

narrative.overview:
Amber is not an accent color. It is a temperature. SentimentAI's design language was built around the conviction that financial data need not be cold, clinical, or forbidding. The interface is warm enough to invite attention and precise enough to earn trust. Every decision begins from that tension: warmth that does not compromise authority.

The system runs on a restrained palette of tinted warm neutrals anchored by a single amber point (#D97706). Frosted glass surfaces create a sense of layered depth without visual drama. Interaction feedback is deliberately quiet: hover states lift, not shout; state transitions complete in under 200ms; nothing competes with the chart data.

This system explicitly rejects three failure modes: the crypto-dark aesthetic (neon on black), the generic SaaS dashboard template (identical cards, gradient text, badge clusters), and the academic-report style (PowerPoint screenshots).
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream-and-amber foundation that reads as intentional, not incidental
Single amber accent used at 10% surface coverage or less; its rarity is structural
Frosted glass elevation used purposefully, not as a universal surface default
Type hierarchy through weight and scale contrast exclusively
Sentiment color semantics are the only place color expands beyond the amber/neutral axis
Inter at negative tracking for headlines; system-ui fallback for body

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Burnished Amber (#D97706) is the only chromatic accent. Sentiment colors are semantic exceptions, not decorative choices. Do not add a second accent.

rules.name: The Warm Neutrals Rule
rules.body: No surface, border, or text color is a pure grey. Every neutral leans warm (hue 55-60, chroma 0.003-0.01 in OKLCH). A cool grey anywhere reads as a mistake.

rules.name: The Negative Tracking Rule
rules.body: Headline and display sizes use negative letter-spacing (-0.02em to -0.04em). Never apply negative tracking below 16px.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: All financial numbers, metric values, and percentages use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Proportional numbers in a column read as misaligned.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows and blur appear as state or structural signals. The sidebar is solid. The topbar is solid. The toolbar is solid. Cards are frosted.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: No shadow uses a pure grey or blue base. All shadows use rgba(0,0,0,N) with warm-ambient values (0.05-0.12). The amber glow is the only chromatic shadow.

dos: Do use Burnished Amber (#D97706) as the sole chromatic accent
Do tint every neutral toward hue 55-60 in OKLCH
Do apply negative letter-spacing (-0.02em to -0.04em) to all headline and display sizes
Do enforce font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on all financial figures
Do keep frosted-glass (backdrop-filter: blur) to card-level surfaces only
Do use WCAG AA contrast minimums
Do use sentiment colors (green, rose) exclusively as semantic indicators
Do animate with ease-out cubic curves only
donts: Don't introduce a crypto dark aesthetic: no neon green, purple, or cyan on dark backgrounds
Don't build identical card grids with icon + heading + text repeated uniformly
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe
Don't make frosted-glass cards the default for all surfaces
Don't add a second accent color
Don't add bounce or elastic easing to any transition
